<includeonly><!-- 
// This first part locates the content of the raw file:
-->{{#vardefine:LISTPREFSTRING_RAWTEXT|{{#if:{{{1|}}}|{{#ifexist:{{{1|}}}|{{:{{{1|}}}}}|{{{1|}}}}}|{{:{{FULLPAGENAME}}/raw}}}}}}<!--
// Then check that there is a PREFSTRING tag (also that LISTPREFSTRING_RAWTEXT is not empty):
-->{{#if: {{tag|{{#var:LISTPREFSTRING_RAWTEXT}}|PREFSTRING}}|<!--
// Write the initial part
-->Some dwarves [[Preferences|like]] {{tagentry|{{#var:LISTPREFSTRING_RAWTEXT}}|NAME|2|notfound={{tagvalue|{{#var:LISTPREFSTRING_RAWTEXT}}|NAME_PLURAL}}}} for their <!--
// Now we need a list. This finds if the number of PREFSTRING tags is 1, 2, or more (for list grammar) then does different things for each:
-->{{#switch:{{#strlen:{{#df_foreachtag:{{#var:LISTPREFSTRING_RAWTEXT}}|PREFSTRING|p}}}}
|1=''{{tagvalue|{{#var:LISTPREFSTRING_RAWTEXT}}|PREFSTRING|0}}''
|2=''{{tagvalue|{{#var:LISTPREFSTRING_RAWTEXT}}|PREFSTRING|0}}'' and ''{{tagvalue|{{#var:LISTPREFSTRING_RAWTEXT}}|PREFSTRING|1}}''
|#default=<!--
// For a list, it's more complicated. First, LISTPREFSTRING_LISTSTR is generated, which looks like ONE, TWO, THREE but doesn't have an 'and' in it.
-->{{#vardefine:LISTPREFSTRING_LISTSTR|{{#substr:{{#df_foreachtag:{{#var:LISTPREFSTRING_RAWTEXT}}|PREFSTRING|, ''\2''}}|2}}}}<!--
// Then, add the ', and' to complete the list (with Oxford comma, of course).
       -->{{#substr:{{#var:LISTPREFSTRING_LISTSTR}}|0|{{#strrpos:{{#var:LISTPREFSTRING_LISTSTR}}|,}}}}, and {{#substr:{{#var:LISTPREFSTRING_LISTSTR}}|{{#expr:1+{{#strrpos:{{#var:LISTPREFSTRING_LISTSTR}}|,}}}}}}
}}.}}</includeonly><!--


--><noinclude>Lists all the reasons dwarves like something. For example: 
* <code><nowiki>{{listprefstring|DF2014:Eagle/raw}}</nowiki></code> → {{listprefstring|DF2014:Eagle/raw}}
* <code><nowiki>{{listprefstring|DF2014:Eagle/raw}}</nowiki></code> → {{listprefstring|DF2014:Roc/raw}}
* <code><nowiki>{{listprefstring|DF2014:Nightwing/raw}}</nowiki></code> → {{listprefstring|DF2014:Nightwing/raw}}
* <code><nowiki>{{listprefstring|{{DF2014:Nightwing/raw}}}}</nowiki></code> → {{listprefstring|{{DF2014:Nightwing/raw}}}}

''Note that the reason for using DF2014 examples is merely that the raws for later version(s) have not been added at the time of writing''

Argument can be any of the following:
* Location of the raw file. e.g. <code>DF2014:Nightwing/raw</code>
* Full text of the raw file.
* None (Uses <code><nowiki>{{FULLPAGENAME}}/raw</nowiki></code>)
</noinclude>
